description: Large-load NAICS shortlist for flexibility participation screening using region-level calibrated earnings.

codes.title: Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services
codes.notes: High continuous load; flexibility mainly from batteries, cooling, and non-critical workload shifting.

codes.title: Semiconductor and Related Device Manufacturing
codes.notes: Very high process criticality; limited but valuable DR windows.

codes.title: Refrigerated Warehousing and Storage
codes.notes: Thermal storage characteristics support meaningful shifting/curtailment.

codes.title: Poultry Processing
codes.notes: Large refrigeration and motor loads with moderate scheduling flexibility.

codes.title: Cheese Manufacturing
codes.notes: Cold storage and process batch operations provide moderate flexibility.

codes.title: Industrial Gas Manufacturing
codes.notes: Compression-intensive loads with some dispatchability under constraints.

codes.title: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing
codes.notes: Continuous process operation limits deep curtailment but allows limited flexibility.

codes.title: Ethyl Alcohol Manufacturing
codes.notes: Fermentation and separation steps permit some operational shifting.

codes.title: Petroleum Refineries
codes.notes: Very high load but tight process constraints reduce practical DR depth.

codes.title: Cement Manufacturing
codes.notes: Grinding and kiln support systems can provide event-based flexibility.

codes.title: Paper (except Newsprint) Mills
codes.notes: Steam-electric coupling and continuous process constraints moderate flexibility.

codes.title: Newsprint Mills
codes.notes: Large motors and thermal systems can participate in some DR products.

codes.title: Iron and Steel Mills and Ferroalloy Manufacturing
codes.notes: High electric arc and process loads with constrained response windows.

codes.title: Secondary Smelting and Alloying of Aluminum
codes.notes: Electro-thermal loads provide limited but potentially valuable DR options.

codes.title: Nonferrous Metal (except Copper and Aluminum) Rolling, Drawing, and Extruding
codes.notes: Batch and line balancing can support moderate participation.

codes.title: Automobile Manufacturing
codes.notes: Shift scheduling and paint/body shop loads can provide flexibility.

codes.title: Heavy Duty Truck Manufacturing
codes.notes: Assembly-line scheduling can support selected DR products.

codes.title: Turbine and Turbine Generator Set Units Manufacturing
codes.notes: Machining and test loads may be shifted with production planning.

codes.title: Aircraft Manufacturing
codes.notes: Mission-critical operations constrain deep curtailment.

codes.title: Hydroelectric Power Generation
codes.notes: Included for completeness but often participates as supply-side resource.

codes.title: Sewage Treatment Facilities
codes.notes: Pumping and aeration loads are often shiftable within compliance limits.

codes.title: Hazardous Waste Collection
codes.notes: Facility-level operations can contribute limited DR value.

codes.title: Hazardous Waste Treatment and Disposal
codes.notes: Thermal and treatment loads have constrained but usable flexibility.

codes.title: Materials Recovery Facilities
codes.notes: Sorting and processing can be shifted under event windows.
